verdict.rationale: Fivetran publishes an official MCP server (github.com/fivetran/fivetran-mcp) that lets agents ask read-only questions about connections/syncs and, with scope configuration, perform write/delete operations like copying connections to new destinations. This is a first-party, documented MCP server enabling agent connectivity to Fivetran's platform. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party corroboration of the MCP server's real-world reliability and broader adoption evidence beyond the README.
